body: Advisor notice, 10:18. aida-host PR #7 (BUG-84) is merged and live as 9202973. Builds started from now on receive SIGINT/SIGQUIT with the caller's normal dispositions (verified live: child SigIgn 0x0). Builds that started before 10:17 still carry the old state. A local interrupt-test failure seen from an earlier build should be re-run once before it is treated as real.
subject: Fixed: cargo builds handle SIGINT/SIGQUIT normally again (aida-host 9202973)
